column7: The return of Christ is an important part of our faith. The study of the return of Christ and the end times is known as **eschatology**. Many books on eschatology have been written, and *most of them disagree with each other*! Specifically, they disagree on interpretations (figurative, literal, symbolic), the order and timings of the events in the scriptures. I'm reminded of the saying by the great Pentecostal evangelist Reinhard Bonke - “I will split hairs in heaven when I am done breaking chains on Earth!”
